audience: Anyone who quotes jobs by the hour
series: Flagship #22 (SALES FIRST); audience scope rule (money first, trade only in the product line); week of Oct 12 theme; CMO slate Oct 12 pm
hook: $27.78 an hour looks fine. Break-even is $64.89
hook_say: Your pay over all your hours looks like $27.78 an hour. Count unpaid hours, tax and costs, and break-even is $64.89.

rows.label: Take-home pay you want
rows.say: You want to take home $55,000 a year
rows.why: The calculator's example: $55,000 a year of take-home pay.

rows.label: Hours you work (44 wks x 45)
rows.why: 44 weeks of 45 hours, counting driving, quoting and setup.

rows.label: Pay over all your hours
rows.why: $55,000 divided by 1,980 hours. This is the usual guess.

rows.label: Hours customers pay for (65%)
rows.say: Customers pay for only 1,287 of them
rows.why: 65% of 1,980 hours. The rest is travel, quotes and admin.

rows.label: Tax + business costs
rows.why: About $19,455 of self-employment and income tax plus $9,060 of yearly costs ($755 a month).

rows.label: Break-even per paid hour
rows.why: $83,515 of revenue needed over 1,287 paid hours.

fix.label: Rate where 15% of the price is profit
fix.say: Price it so 15% of each dollar is profit: $76.34 an hour
fix.why: Break-even divided by 0.85, so 15% of every dollar of the price is profit. The calculator's target rate per paid hour.
